page.layout: One page of running text, with a running head at the top, the page number at top left, a closing block centred below the text, a row of asterisk ornaments, and a catchword at the right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: quàm ut irritato malo Reipub. scissuram am-plificemus, dum ignis qui ad momentum so-pitus videbitur, denuò erumpens maiorem fra-gorem edet.

Hæc sunt mi Frater, quæ in præsentia de re-rum nostratium statu eiusdemq; correctione mihi in mentem venerunt, quæq; tuo iudicio subiicere volui. Si quæ autem præter hæc de-sideraueris, illa vel aliunde commodius petere, vel eorundem disquisitionem in nostrum congressum differre poteris. Vale Deo, Patriæ, tibi tuisque.

page.notes: The asterisk ornaments below the closing words ("* *" and "*") are printer's ornaments, not text, so they are left out. The catchword at the right is spaced out and its last letters are doubtful; it is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. "sciffuram" in the scan is read as scissuram. Hyphenated line breaks are joined with their printed hyphens. The paragraph break before "Hæc sunt" is an indent.
